versions.changelog:
Initial release of the AI Intelligent AR/VR Platform.

- Supports AR (augmented reality) and VR (virtual reality) application development
- Includes 3D scene building and gesture-based interactive design
- Enables multi-user collaboration for immersive shared experiences
- Offers tiered pricing plans for basic, professional, and enterprise use
- Suitable for gaming, education, real estate, and industrial simulation applications
